We propose that an Attention-based Semantic Priming (ASP) approach can be used to improve sequence labeling in spoken language understanding.

1) an attention-based RNN architecture can simulate semantic priming phenomena for the slot-filling task; 2) semantic priming can be simulated using pretrained word embeddings to capture semantic relationship between utterance and label; and 3) the proposed approach can achieve up to 1-2% improvement in F-score for the slot-filing task.
